cards.summary: 论文提出TGSF框架，联合稠密主题发现（Top2Vec）与关系图嵌入（Node2Vec），在单位超球面上融合语义与结构表示后KMeans聚类。在ACORD、CUAD和LEDGAR三个法律数据集上，TGSF的NMI和ARI优于语义单模态、结构单模态、LDA、NMF和TF-IDF基线。作者通过大规模超参数网格与贝叶斯优化实验，并分析超参数敏感性。
cards.description: 提出双流形表示学习框架TGSF，将主题语义发现与图嵌入统一到单位超球面，在三个法律基准上提升了无监督聚类指标，为标注稀缺的法律文本挖掘提供可复现方法。
cards.whyItMatters: 法律文书专业术语密集、长度差异大且专家标注稀缺，TGSF提供了一种无需标注即可融合主题语义与文档关系结构的聚类方案，并公开了超参数敏感性诊断，有助于推动可复现的法律文本挖掘研究。
cards.titleEn: Unsupervised Legal Document Clustering via Hybrid Topic-Semantic Labeling and Graph Embeddings
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes TGSF, which combines dense topic discovery (Top2Vec) and relational graph embeddings (Node2Vec) and fuses semantic and structural representations on a unit hypersphere before KMeans clustering. On ACORD, CUAD, and LEDGAR, TGSF outperforms semantic-only, structural-only, LDA, NMF, and TF-IDF baselines in NMI and ARI. The authors conduct large-scale hyperparameter grid and Bayesian optimization experiments and analyze hyperparameter sensitivity.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Legal documents feature specialized terminology, variable lengths, and scarce expert annotations; TGSF offers an annotation-free clustering approach that fuses topic semantics with document relational structure, and its hyperparameter sensitivity diagnostics support reproducible legal text mining research.
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces TGSF, a dual-manifold representation learning framework that unifies topic-semantic discovery and graph embeddings on a joint unit hypersphere, improving unsupervised clustering metrics on three legal benchmarks and offering a reproducible method for annotation-scarce legal text mining.
keyPoints: TGSF构建多关系文档-主题图，融合多主题质心桥与温度锐化语义k-NN边，保证单连通分量。
语义与图表示经L2归一化后按模态加权拼接于联合单位超球面，再KMeans划分，平方弦距离分解为语义与结构余弦相似度的凸组合。
在LEDGAR上NMI从0.606升至0.653（ARI=0.425），ACORD从0.228升至0.284（ARI=0.260），CUAD从0.535升至0.570（ARI=0.282）。
keyPointsEn: TGSF constructs a multi-relational document-topic graph combining multi-topic centroid bridges with temperature-sharpened semantic k-NN document edges, guaranteeing a single connected component.

L2-normalized semantic and graph representations are fused via modality-weighted concatenation on a joint unit hypersphere before KMeans partitioning, decomposing squared chordal distance into a convex combination of semantic and structural cosine similarities.
NMI improves from 0.606 to 0.653 on LEDGAR (ARI=0.425), from 0.228 to 0.284 on ACORD (ARI=0.260), and from 0.535 to 0.570 on CUAD (ARI=0.282).
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自三个法律基准数据集（ACORD、CUAD、LEDGAR）和文中设定的基线比较；未涉及其他语言或非法律领域的外部验证；超参数优化采用216种网格配置与每数据集240次贝叶斯/多目标优化试验，结论依赖该搜索空间；NMI与ARI的绝对提升幅度有限，且未报告聚类结果在下游法律任务中的效用。
cards.originalTitle: Hybrid Topic-Semantic Labeling and Graph Embeddings for Unsupervised Legal Document Clustering
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from three legal benchmark datasets (ACORD, CUAD, LEDGAR) and the baselines compared in the paper; no external validation on other languages or non-legal domains is provided; hyperparameter optimization uses 216 grid configurations and 240 Bayesian/multi-objective trials per dataset, so conclusions depend on that search space; NMI and ARI improvements are modest in absolute terms, and the utility of clustering results in downstream legal tasks is not reported.
cards.title: 主题-语义标签与图嵌入融合的无监督法律文书聚类

cards.summary: 作者提出递归函数分解（RFD），把长程预测映射分解为三次参数共享的分块预测，各块覆盖互不重叠的未来区间并拼接，而非按趋势、季节或残差分量相加；每个生成块会并入滚动上下文以条件化下一次应用。三随机种子受控实验显示，移除前向反馈会损害全部四个数据集的性能，而阻断其梯度影响很小，表明有用信号是不断演化的预测状态本身。在冻结长上下文评估中，RFD 在24个单元中的23个取得更低测试误差，但该比较跨协议，且其顺序通道执行在高通道数下比迭代基线更慢、更耗内存。
cards.description: 该工作提出递归函数分解（RFD），将长程预测映射分解为三次参数共享的分块预测，用顺序计算换取存储参数。其价值在于：在受控实验中仅用0.08–0.46M参数即可与十个强基线对比，并在24个测试单元中23个取得更低误差。
cards.whyItMatters: 它为长程时序预测提供了一种“少参数、多顺序计算”的替代设计，并指出滚动预测状态本身可能是主要信息来源，这对模型压缩与推理成本权衡的研究有参考价值。
cards.titleEn: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting: A New Operator Design for Long-Horizon Time Series
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD), which factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions; the blocks occupy disjoint future intervals and are concatenated rather than added as trend, seasonal, or residual components, and each emitted block joins the rolling context that conditions the next application. Three-seed controlled experiments show that removing forward feedback hurts all four evaluated datasets, while stopping gradients through it changes little, indicating the useful signal is the evolving forecast state itself. In a frozen long-context evaluation, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells, but the comparison is cross-protocol, and its sequential channel-wise execution is slower and more memory-intensive than an iterative baseline at high channel count.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a low-parameter, high-sequential-compute alternative design for long-horizon forecasting and suggests the rolling forecast state itself may be the main source of information, which is relevant to research on model compression and inference-cost trade-offs.
cards.descriptionEn: The work proposes Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD), which factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions, trading sequential computation for stored parameters. Its value: in controlled experiments with only 0.08–0.46M parameters, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells against ten strong baseline families.
keyPoints: RFD 通过重复调用同一参数共享算子生成连续未来块，以顺序计算换取参数存储，模型规模仅 0.08–0.46M 参数。
受控实验发现前向反馈（滚动上下文）是性能关键，而阻断其间梯度影响很小；重复应用共享算子有稳定收益，但小于直接加宽算子。
冻结长上下文对比中 RFD 在 24 个单元里 23 个误差更低，但属跨协议比较（RFD 用 512/720 步上下文，基线用 96 步），且顺序执行在高通道数下更慢更耗内存。
keyPointsEn: RFD reuses one parameter-shared operator to emit contiguous future blocks, trading sequential computation for parameter storage, with only 0.08–0.46M parameters.
Controlled experiments find forward feedback (rolling context) is key, while stopping gradients through it changes little; reapplying the shared operator helps consistently but less than widening it.

In the frozen long-context comparison RFD has lower error in 23 of 24 cells, but the comparison is cross-protocol (RFD uses 512/720-step context, baselines use 96), and sequential execution is slower and more memory-intensive at high channel count.
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：性能结论来自三随机种子受控实验与冻结长上下文评估，后者为跨协议比较、基线上下文长度仅 96 步，不能直接等同于同条件优势；未报告统计显著性；顺序通道执行在高通道数下慢于迭代基线且更耗内存；结论限于所评估的四个数据集与十个基线家族。
cards.originalTitle: Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries are explicit: performance conclusions come from three-seed controlled experiments and a frozen long-context evaluation that is cross-protocol, with baselines using only 96-step context, so they do not directly equal same-condition superiority; statistical significance is not reported; sequential channel-wise execution is slower than the iterative baseline and more memory-intensive at high channel count; conclusions are limited to the four evaluated datasets and ten baseline families.
cards.title: 参数共享分块预测：长程时序预测的新算子设计

cards.summary: 输入内容显示 makecindy/cindy 出现在 GitHub Trending Daily 榜单。项目自述为“开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent”，并给出“想到，就能做到”的口号。除此之外，来源未提供功能细节、实现方式或评测数据。
cards.description: 该条内容介绍新近出现在 GitHub Trending 每日榜单上的开源项目 makecindy/cindy，其自述定位为“开箱即用”的 AI Agent。新意在于以开源、零配置可用为卖点切入 Agent 工具领域；用处是让关注 AI 工具的人了解这一新出现的候选项目入口。
cards.whyItMatters: 开源且强调开箱即用的 Agent 项目，降低了关注者的试用门槛，也为追踪 AI 工具生态动向提供了一个新的观察对象。
cards.titleEn: Open-Source Out-of-the-Box AI Agent Cindy Hits Trending
cards.summaryEn: The input shows makecindy/cindy appearing on GitHub Trending Daily. The project describes itself as an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent with the slogan 'think it, do it'. The source offers no further details on features, implementation, or evaluation.
cards.whyItMattersEn: An open-source agent that emphasizes out-of-the-box use lowers the barrier to trying it and offers a new reference point for tracking the AI tooling ecosystem.
cards.descriptionEn: This entry covers makecindy/cindy, an open-source project newly listed on GitHub Trending Daily that bills itself as an out-of-the-box AI agent. Its novelty is the open-source, zero-setup positioning; its usefulness is as a pointer for people tracking new AI tooling.

自述定位为开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent
来源信息仅含标语式简介，未披露具体能力

It positions itself as an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent
The source provides only a slogan-level description, with no capability details

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from a GitHub Trending listing and the project's own slogan; it is not independently verified. The source provides no feature list, architecture, benchmarks, license terms, or maintenance activity, so actual usability and maturity cannot be judged. This card is not selection or investment advice.
cards.title: 开源即用型 AI Agent 项目 Cindy 登上趋势榜

cards.summary: CasePlay 提出一种文档驱动的自博弈强化学习框架，将临床病例报告转化为训练信号，无需专家标注问题。作者识别出知识固着和难度-质量不匹配两个限制现有自博弈方法的问题，并设计知识条件化提议器与评分标准判断推理器予以应对。实验显示其在七个医疗基准上优于现有自博弈基线，平均提升 SFT 热启动模型 3.1 分，LiveClin 提升 6.3 分。
cards.description: 针对现有医疗LLM强化学习依赖专家标注或昂贵合成数据的问题，CasePlay利用未标注病例报告进行自博弈训练，通过知识条件化提议器和评分标准判断推理器，缓解知识点固着与难度-质量不匹配，在七个医疗基准上平均提升3.1分。
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法表明，未经标注的临床病例报告可通过自博弈转化为有效的强化学习信号，为持续提升医疗大模型推理能力提供了一条不依赖专家标注或高成本合成数据的路径。
cards.titleEn: CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning
cards.summaryEn: CasePlay proposes a document-grounded self-play reinforcement learning framework that converts clinical case reports into training signals without expert-labeled questions. The authors identify knowledge-point fixation and difficulty-quality mismatch as limiting existing self-play methods, and design a Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer and a Rubric-Judge Reasoner to address them. Experiments show it outperforms existing self-play baselines on seven medical benchmarks, improving an SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average and by 6.3 points on LiveClin.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This approach shows that unlabeled clinical case reports can be converted into effective RL signals via self-play, offering a path to continuously improve medical LLM reasoning without expert labels or costly synthetic data.
cards.descriptionEn: To address reliance on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic data in RL for medical LLMs, CasePlay uses unlabeled case reports for self-play training, with a knowledge-conditioned proposer and rubric-judge reasoner to mitigate knowledge-point fixation and difficulty-quality mismatch, improving an average of 3.1 points across seven medical benchmarks.
keyPoints: 知识条件化提议器将问题生成锚定到病例特定知识点，促使问题覆盖更广泛的证据。
评分标准判断推理器在答案准确性之外，增加对线索整合、推理深度和选项质量的反馈。
在七个医疗基准上平均提升3.1分，LiveClin上提升6.3分。
keyPointsEn: The Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points, encouraging broader evidence coverage.
The Rubric-Judge Reasoner adds rubric-based feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality beyond answer accuracy.
Average improvement of 3.1 points across seven medical benchmarks and 6.3 points on LiveClin.
cards.limitations: 证据边界限于论文所选七个医疗基准和特定热启动模型，尚未证明对其他模型、临床真实场景或更广泛医学专科的泛化性；自博弈训练仍依赖评分标准与判断模型的质量，长期临床有效性未经前瞻验证。
cards.originalTitle: CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is bounded by the seven selected medical benchmarks and the specific warm-start model; generalization to other models, real clinical settings, or broader specialties is not established, and self-play training still depends on rubric and judge quality, with long-term clinical validity not prospectively validated.
cards.title: CasePlay：基于病例报告自博弈强化学习提升医疗推理

cards.summary: 该研究构建2015—2025年695家公司共7000个公司—年度样本，作为Acemoglu等“租金分享衰落”研究的后续。在75家持续披露员工开支的固定样本中，人均名义营收增长83.6%，人均员工开支增长51.0%；但这一差距主要集中于金融企业，其他25家 reporter 的人均员工开支增速略高于人均营收。作者强调，这些会计指标既不能识别真实生产率，也不能说明收益在劳动与资本间的分配。
cards.description: 该研究以上市公司财务数据复核“租金分享衰落”推断，指出营收与员工开支差距扩大主要集中于金融企业，会计指标无法识别真实生产率或劳资分配。
cards.whyItMatters: 它为使用公司财务数据推断租金分享变化的研究提供了重要的测量边界提醒：报告选择与行业构成会显著影响结论，不能将会计比率直接解读为生产率或劳资分配变化。
cards.titleEn: Wider Revenue–Staff Expense Gap Does Not Prove Declining Rent-Sharing
cards.summaryEn: This study assembles 7,000 company-years for 695 firms over 2015–2025 as a follow-up to Acemoglu, He, and le Maire's 'Eclipse of Rent-Sharing.' In a fixed sample of 75 staff-expense reporters, nominal revenue per employee rises 83.6% while staff expense per employee rises 51.0%, but the gap is concentrated in financial firms; among the other 25 reporters, aggregate staff expense per employee grows slightly faster than aggregate revenue per employee. The author stresses that these accounting measures identify neither real productivity nor the allocation of gains between labor and capital.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides an important measurement caveat for research inferring changes in rent-sharing from corporate financial data: reporting selection and sector composition can materially affect conclusions, and accounting ratios should not be read directly as productivity or labor–capital allocation changes.
cards.descriptionEn: Using public-company accounts, this follow-up re-examines inferences about declining rent-sharing and shows that the widening revenue–staff expense gap is concentrated in financial firms; accounting measures cannot identify real productivity or labor–capital allocation.
keyPoints: 75家固定样本中人均营收增长83.6%，人均员工开支增长51.0%，总费用收入比下降。
费用收入比下降集中于金融企业；其余25家人均员工开支增速略高于人均营收。
对原论文的审计发现，部分美国产出效应估计仍不精确，丹麦部分估计支持更紧的边界。
keyPointsEn: In the 75-firm fixed sample, revenue per employee rises 83.6% and staff expense per employee rises 51.0%, with the pooled expense-to-revenue ratio falling.
The decline in the expense-to-revenue ratio is concentrated in financial firms; among the other 25 reporters, staff expense per employee grows slightly faster than revenue per employee.
An audit of the original paper finds some US output effects remain imprecisely estimated, while several Danish estimates support tighter bounds.
cards.limitations: 样本仅覆盖695家美国上市公司2015—2025年数据，固定样本仅75家持续披露员工开支的企业；报告概率模型存在权重集中、两组不平衡和部分行业无报告者的问题，不能推广薪资结果。会计指标不识别真实生产率或收益分配；研究既不确认也不推翻原论文的因果工资与劳动份额结论。
cards.originalTitle: Revenue Growth and Staff Expense: A Public-Company Follow-Up to Eclipse of Rent-Sharing
cards.limitationsEn: The sample covers only 695 US public firms over 2015–2025, and the fixed sample includes only 75 firms that consistently report staff expense; the fitted reporting-probability model exhibits concentrated weights, substantial two-group imbalance, and sectors without reporters, so payroll results cannot be generalized. Accounting measures do not identify real productivity or gain allocation; the study neither confirms nor overturns the original paper's causal wage and labor-share findings.
cards.title: 企业营收与员工开支差距扩大未必证明租金分享下降

cards.summary: 研究指出现有安全对齐难以应对领域隐性风险，构建了3000条标注查询数据集，并在14个领先大模型上测得平均57.8%的越狱成功率。作者提出MENTOR框架，通过元认知自评估、视角转换与后果推理发现潜在错位，并选择性触发进化循环修正不安全响应、蒸馏规则图、编译为激活级引导信号。实验称MENTOR在所有测试领域显著降低攻击成功率并优于现有安全对齐方法。
cards.description: 现有安全措施常忽视领域特定的隐性风险。该研究构建了覆盖教育、金融、管理的3000条标注查询数据集，发现14个主流大模型平均越狱成功率达57.8%，并提出元认知驱动的自进化框架MENTOR以降低攻击成功率。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将安全评估从通用越狱拓展到领域隐性风险，并给出可自我进化的缓解框架，为LLM在敏感领域的部署安全提供了新思路与可复用数据集。
cards.titleEn: MENTOR: A Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution Framework for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs
cards.summaryEn: The study identifies a gap in safety alignment for implicit domain risks, constructs a 3,000-query annotated dataset, and measures an average jailbreak success rate of 57.8% across 14 leading LLMs. The authors propose MENTOR, which performs metacognitive self-assessment using perspective-taking and consequential reasoning, selectively invokes an evolution cycle to revise unsafe responses, distills corrections into a dynamic rule graph, and compiles rules into activation-level steering signals. Experiments report that MENTOR substantially reduces attack success rates across all tested domains and outperforms existing safety alignment methods.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work extends safety evaluation from generic jailbreaks to implicit domain risks and offers a self-evolving mitigation framework, providing new ideas and a reusable dataset for safer LLM deployment in sensitive domains.
cards.descriptionEn: Current safety measures often overlook implicit, domain-specific risks. This study builds a 3,000-query annotated dataset spanning education, finance, and management, finds an average jailbreak success rate of 57.8% across 14 leading LLMs, and proposes the metacognition-driven self-evolution framework MENTOR to reduce attack success rates.
keyPoints: 构建覆盖教育、金融、管理三个领域的3000条标注查询数据集，用于评估领域隐性风险。
在14个领先大模型上平均越狱成功率达57.8%，显示现有安全措施的不足。
MENTOR结合单次规则引导推理与选择性元认知进化循环，将修正经验蒸馏为动态规则图并编译为激活级引导信号。
keyPointsEn: Builds a 3,000-query annotated dataset covering education, finance, and management to assess implicit domain risks.
Measures an average jailbreak success rate of 57.8% across 14 leading LLMs, highlighting gaps in current safety measures.

MENTOR couples single-pass rule-guided inference with a selectively invoked metacognitive evolution cycle that distills corrections into a dynamic rule graph and compiles them into activation-level steering signals.
cards.limitations: 摘要仅报告了平均越狱成功率与相对优势，未给出各模型、各领域的具体数值、统计显著性及误报率等证据；MENTOR的规则图蒸馏与激活级引导依赖模型内部访问，其跨架构泛化性与长期稳定性尚未验证；数据集规模与领域覆盖有限，结论边界需以论文全文为准。
cards.originalTitle: MENTOR: A Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution Framework for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract reports only average jailbreak success rates and relative advantages, without per-model or per-domain values, statistical significance, or false-positive rates. MENTOR's rule-graph distillation and activation-level steering rely on internal model access, and cross-architecture generalization and long-term stability remain unverified. The dataset's scale and domain coverage are limited; evidence boundaries should be confirmed against the full paper.
cards.title: MENTOR框架：用元认知自进化揭示并缓解大模型领域隐性风险

cards.summary: SpatialScout是一个包含80个室内场景、3140个目标物体的基准，要求智能体在有限交互预算下主动选择视角、关联跨视图观测并估计物体中心坐标。实验显示最强模型Claude Opus 5.5的平均重叠分数仅41.71%，仅3.25%的目标IoU超过0.9，表明从粗略布局恢复完整精确度量地图仍很困难。作者认为该基准可推动主动感知与三维表示学习的研究。
cards.description: 该研究推出SpatialScout基准，首次系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体通过主动控制相机探索室内场景并构建物体级三维度量地图的能力。其价值在于揭示当前前沿模型在主动感知与精确建图之间的显著差距，为开发更可靠的三维空间智能体提供量化测试平台。
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准将空间智能评测从静态问答推进到主动探索与度量建图，有助于量化诊断VLM在视角规划、跨视图关联和几何估计上的短板，为研发能构建可靠三维空间表示的智能体提供可复现的测试床。
cards.titleEn: SpatialScout: Benchmarking VLM Agents for Active Exploration and 3D Mapping
cards.summaryEn: SpatialScout is a benchmark of 80 indoor scenes with 3,140 target objects, requiring agents to actively select viewpoints, associate cross-view observations, and estimate object centers under bounded interaction budgets. Experiments show the strongest model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves only 41.71% mean overlap score, with 3.25% of targets exceeding 0.9 IoU, indicating difficulty in constructing complete and precise metric maps. The authors position it as a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark moves spatial intelligence evaluation from static question answering to active exploration and metric mapping, helping quantify VLM shortcomings in viewpoint planning, cross-view association, and geometric estimation, and offering a reproducible testbed for agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations.
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces SpatialScout, a benchmark that systematically evaluates vision-language model (VLM) agents' ability to actively control a camera to explore indoor scenes and build object-level 3D metric maps. It is useful for revealing the gap between current frontier models' coarse layout recovery and precise mapping, providing a quantitative testbed for spatial intelligence research.
keyPoints: SpatialScout包含80个室内场景和3140个目标物体，任务要求智能体主动控制相机探索并输出物体中心在共享坐标系中的估计。
评估采用物体尺度重叠分数，同时惩罚漏检并衡量定位精度与目标覆盖率。
前沿VLM表现有限：最强模型平均重叠分数41.71%，IoU>0.5的目标占47.23%，IoU>0.9仅3.25%。
keyPointsEn: SpatialScout contains 80 indoor scenes and 3,140 target objects; agents must actively control a camera to explore and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame.
Evaluation uses object-scale overlap scores that jointly measure localization accuracy and target coverage while penalizing missing predictions.
Frontier VLMs show limited performance: the best model achieves 41.71% mean overlap, 47.23% of targets above IoU 0.5, and only 3.25% above IoU 0.9.
cards.limitations: 证据边界包括：仅评测80个室内场景和3140个目标物体，场景与目标类型有限；任务限定为物体级中心点估计，不涉及完整场景几何或语义建图；结果基于特定交互预算和IoU阈值，不能直接外推到开放环境或真实机器人部署；论文未报告所有基线模型的完整对比与误差分析。
cards.originalTitle: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries include: evaluation is limited to 80 indoor scenes and 3,140 target objects with restricted scene and object types; the task is confined to object-level center estimation and does not cover full scene geometry or semantic mapping; results depend on specific interaction budgets and IoU thresholds and cannot be directly extrapolated to open environments or real robot deployment; the paper does not report complete comparisons and error analyses for all baseline models.
cards.title: SpatialScout：VLM智能体主动探索与三维建图的能力评测

cards.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个开源、可完全本地运行的语音工具，功能范围包括语音克隆、音色设计、视频配音、听写、转写与有声书制作。项目简介称其支持 646 种语言，作为 ElevenLabs 的开源替代。以上信息来自项目自述与趋势榜摘要，未提供性能、质量或合规方面的实测证据。
cards.description: 该项目在 GitHub 趋势榜出现，定位为完全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 开源替代，把语音克隆、音色设计、视频配音、听写、转写与有声书制作整合到同一工具中，并声称支持 646 种语言。其新意在于以开源方式覆盖多种语音生成与转写任务，并以本地运行为卖点；对关注数据自主与自托管语音工具的开发者和团队有参考价值。
cards.whyItMatters: 语音克隆与合成通常依赖云端服务，本地运行的开源方案可能为重视数据不出本机、可自托管与可定制的用户提供另一种选择；把克隆、配音、转写与有声书制作放在同一工具内，也便于评估端到端工作流。
cards.titleEn: VoiceStudio: an open-source, fully local voice studio
cards.summaryEn: VoiceStudio is an open-source voice tool designed to run fully locally, covering voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation. The project description claims support for 646 languages and positions itself as an open-source alternative to ElevenLabs. This information comes from the project's own description and a trending summary; no measured evidence on performance, quality or compliance is provided.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Voice cloning and synthesis usually rely on cloud services; a locally run, open-source option may offer an alternative for users who value keeping data on-device, self-hosting and customization. Combining cloning, dubbing, transcription and audiobook creation in one tool also makes end-to-end workflows easier to evaluate.
cards.descriptionEn: This project appears on GitHub Trending as a fully local, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs, bundling voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation in one tool, with a claimed 646-language scope. Its novelty is combining multiple speech generation and transcription tasks in an open-source, locally run package; it is relevant to developers and teams prioritizing data autonomy and self-hosted voice tooling.
keyPoints: 定位为 ElevenLabs 的开源替代，核心卖点是完全本地运行
功能覆盖语音克隆、音色设计、视频配音、听写、转写与有声书制作
项目简介声称支持 646 种语言
keyPointsEn: Positioned as an open-source alternative to ElevenLabs, with fully local operation as the core selling point
Covers voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation
The project description claims support for 646 languages
cards.limitations: 现有信息仅为 GitHub 趋势摘要与项目自述，缺少模型清单、依赖与硬件要求、许可证细节、合成与转写质量评测、语言支持的验证方式，以及语音克隆涉及的授权与合规说明；不宜据此判断实际可用性与效果。
cards.limitationsEn: The available information is limited to a GitHub Trending summary and the project's own description. It lacks model lists, dependency and hardware requirements, license details, quality evaluations for synthesis and transcription, the method used to verify language support, and authorization or compliance notes for voice cloning. It should not be used to judge practical usability or effectiveness.
cards.title: VoiceStudio：可本地运行的开源语音工作室

cards.summary: 高风险表格管道依赖分散、静态的质量检查，难以演进和对照策略意图审计，受监管领域对可追溯性与问责制期望更高。作者提出本体论支撑、仓库原生的数据质量层愿景，强调规则作为一等工件，并实现智能体规则发现核心作为初步验证。在金融与零售两个真实工业数据集上的初步结果显示，全自主分治式智能体规则发现可产出与人类专家指定规则在质量和多样性上相当的结果。
cards.description: 提出一种本体论支撑、仓库原生的数据质量层愿景，将规则作为版本化、溯源链接治理文本且可重放的一等工件。作为验证该愿景的第一步，实现了智能体规则发现核心，包含全自主与引导两种规则获取模式及人机协同审查界面。
cards.whyItMatters: 为受监管的高风险表格管道提供可审计、可溯源、可重放的数据质量规则管理思路，回应LLM时代自动化对可追溯性和问责制的更高要求，并初步验证智能体自主发现规则替代人工指定的可行性。
cards.titleEn: AuDQ: Auditable Data Quality through Agentic Rule Discovery
cards.summaryEn: High-stakes tabular pipelines rely on scattered, static quality checks that are hard to evolve and audit against policy intent, and regulated domains face rising expectations for traceability and accountability. The authors propose an ontology-grounded, repository-native data quality layer vision treating rules as first-class artifacts, and implement an agentic rule-discovery core as an initial validation step. Preliminary results on two real-world industry datasets in finance and retail indicate that fully autonomous divide-and-conquer agentic rule discovery produces rules of comparable quality and diversity to those specified by a human expert.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers an auditable, traceable, and replayable approach to data quality rule management for regulated high-stakes tabular pipelines, responding to higher expectations for traceability and accountability in the LLM era of automation, and preliminarily validates the feasibility of agentic autonomous rule discovery as an alternative to manual specification.
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a vision for an ontology-grounded, repository-native data quality layer where rules are first-class artifacts that are versioned, provenance-linked to governance texts, and replayable via immutable execution traces. As a first step, implements the agentic rule-discovery core with two acquisition modes (Full-Agentic and Guided) and a human-in-the-loop review interface.
keyPoints: 规则被设计为一等工件：版本化、与治理文本溯源链接、通过不可变执行痕迹可重放。
智能体规则发现核心提供全自主（Full-Agentic）与引导（Guided）两种规则获取模式，并配有人机协同审查界面。
在金融和零售两个真实工业数据集上的初步实验表明，全自主分治式智能体规则发现产出的规则在质量与多样性上与人类专家规则相当。
keyPointsEn: Rules are designed as first-class artifacts: versioned, provenance-linked to governance texts, and replayable through immutable execution traces.
The agentic rule-discovery core offers two rule acquisition modes (Full-Agentic and Guided) with a human-in-the-loop review interface.

Preliminary experiments on two real-world industry datasets in finance and retail show that fully autonomous divide-and-conquer agentic rule discovery yields rules comparable in quality and diversity to human-expert-specified rules.
cards.limitations: 本文仅为愿景性工作，智能体规则发现核心是朝该愿景迈出的第一步，尚未完整实现本体论支撑、仓库原生的数据质量层。实验仅基于金融和零售两个真实工业数据集，报告的是初步结果，未提供大规模或跨领域验证，也未与人类专家规则进行全面的统计比较。规则质量与多样性的评估框架细节及实验规模有限，结论的外推需谨慎。
cards.originalTitle: AuDQ: Auditable Data Quality through Agentic Rule Discovery
cards.limitationsEn: This is a vision paper; the agentic rule-discovery core is a first step toward the vision, and the full ontology-grounded, repository-native data quality layer is not yet implemented. Experiments are based only on two real-world industry datasets in finance and retail, report preliminary results, and lack large-scale or cross-domain validation as well as comprehensive statistical comparison with human-expert rules. The evaluation framework for rule quality and diversity is limited in detail and experimental scale, so conclusions should be extrapolated with caution.
cards.title: AuDQ：智能体规则发现实现可审计数据质量

cards.summary: 本文扩展了阻尼正弦（DSINC）方法，使其适用于一般单因子随机波动率模型，而不再局限于仿射Heston类。作者证明塌缩恒等式在这些模型中依然有效，并针对3/2模型和SABR给出闭式或Bessel表示。数值测试显示与精细有限差分基准在行权价一个基点内吻合，计算成本相当或更低。
cards.description: 该研究将DSINC方法从仿射Heston类推广到一般单因子随机波动率模型，证明塌缩恒等式仍成立，并给出3/2模型和SABR的闭式或Bessel表示，为美式期权定价提供更广适用性。
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法将DSINC的适用范围从Heston类扩展到3/2、SABR、GARCH和对数正态波动率等非仿射模型，为美式期权定价提供了一种不依赖对数价格网格的高效替代方案。
cards.titleEn: DSINC Method Extended to Non-Affine Stochastic Volatility Models
cards.summaryEn: This paper extends the damped-sinc (DSINC) method to general one-factor stochastic volatility models beyond the affine Heston class. The author shows that the collapse identity remains valid for these models and provides closed-form or Bessel representations for the 3/2 model and SABR. Numerical tests show agreement with fine finite-difference benchmarks to within one basis point of the strike, with comparable or lower computational cost.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method extends DSINC from the Heston class to non-affine models such as 3/2, SABR, GARCH, and lognormal volatility, offering an efficient alternative for American option pricing that avoids a log-price grid.
cards.descriptionEn: This study extends the DSINC method from the affine Heston class to general one-factor stochastic volatility models, proves the collapse identity remains valid, and provides closed-form or Bessel representations for the 3/2 model and SABR, broadening applicability for American option pricing.
keyPoints: 塌缩恒等式对一般单因子随机波动率模型仍成立，阻尼参数在0到1之间可接受。
3/2模型获得基于Kummer函数的闭式联合变换，无相关SABR获得Bessel表示。
无闭式变换时，可通过逐频率求解一个后向方程直接计算波动率积分，无需对数价格网格。
keyPointsEn: The collapse identity remains valid for general one-factor stochastic volatility models, with damping between zero and one admissible.
Closed-form joint transforms in terms of Kummer functions are obtained for the 3/2 model, and a Bessel representation for uncorrelated SABR.
When a closed-form transform is unavailable, the volatility integral is computed directly by solving one backward equation per frequency, without a log-price grid.
cards.limitations: 数值验证仅针对3/2、SABR、GARCH和对数正态波动率模型，与有限差分基准比较；无相关SABR的Hankel实现计算较慢；未讨论高维或多因子扩展；实际应用需模型参数校准，且闭式变换并非对所有模型可得。
cards.originalTitle: DSINC beyond Heston: the 3/2 and other non-affine stochastic-volatility models
cards.limitationsEn: Numerical validation is limited to the 3/2, SABR, GARCH, and lognormal volatility models against finite-difference benchmarks; the Hankel implementation for uncorrelated SABR is slower; high-dimensional or multi-factor extensions are not discussed; practical use requires model calibration, and closed-form transforms are not available for all models.
cards.title: DSINC方法扩展至非仿射随机波动率模型

cards.summary: 事实：TARSphere 由仿真基础设施、具身大脑 harness 与基准三部分组成；基础设施在含具身 NPC 和受限对话的物理仿真中运行机器人策略，以事件驱动有限状态机依据已完成动作与已传递信息更新任务状态并评估结果；harness 让冻结的多模态大模型通过多级可执行技能行动，并利用观测、分层记忆与执行反馈修正决策。基准包含30个室内场景的360个情节，设五组配对条件，覆盖导航报告与取送任务。作者报告对8个多模态大模型的评估显示通用模型可优于具身模型，任务更新与人机交互仍困难，频繁碰撞和跌落促使在任务成功之外评估执行安全。上述比较结论属于作者基于其基准与设定的报告。
cards.description: 该工作提出一个机器人导向的全栈框架，把物理仿真、事件驱动任务状态更新与冻结多模态大模型的可执行技能调用结合起来，并在30个室内场景的360个情节上构造基准，用于评估感知鲁棒性、扰动适应、任务更新、人机协作与意图理解。其有用性在于将长程具身评测置于物理与社会约束及动态变化之中，并同时关注执行安全。
cards.whyItMatters: 长程具身任务在真实环境中会因物理约束、社会规范与需求变化而动态演化。该工作把任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何纳入评测构造，并在共享动作接口和决策预算下同时观察任务成功与执行安全，为比较不同多模态大模型在动态物理与社会环境中的长程表现提供了可操作的评测框架。
cards.titleEn: TARSphere: A Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
cards.summaryEn: Facts: TARSphere consists of simulation infrastructure, an embodied-brain harness, and a benchmark. The infrastructure runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue, using an event-driven finite-state machine to update task states and evaluate outcomes based on completed actions and delivered information. The harness lets a frozen multimodal large language model act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise decisions. The benchmark contains 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes with five paired conditions covering navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. The authors report that evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, task updates and human interaction remain difficult, and frequent collisions and falls motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success. These comparative claims are the authors' reports under their benchmark and settings.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Long-horizon embodied tasks evolve dynamically under physical constraints, social norms, and changing needs. This work incorporates task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry into benchmark construction, and observes both task success and execution safety under a shared action interface and decision budget, offering an operable evaluation framework for comparing multimodal large models in dynamic physical and social environments over long horizons.
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes a robot-oriented full-stack framework that combines physics simulation, event-driven task-state updates, and executable skill calls by a frozen multimodal large language model, and builds a benchmark of 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes to assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task updates, human coordination, and intent understanding. Its usefulness lies in placing long-horizon embodied evaluation within physical and social constraints an
keyPoints: 框架将物理仿真、社会约束（具身 NPC 与受限对话）和事件驱动任务状态更新整合为长程具身智能体的评测闭环。
冻结多模态大模型通过多级可执行技能、观测、分层记忆与执行反馈进行决策修正，无需微调模型本身。
基准含30个室内场景的360个情节，以五组配对条件分别考察感知鲁棒、扰动适应、任务更新、人机协作与意图理解。
作者对8个多模态大模型的评估称通用模型可优于具身模型，任务更新与人机交互仍具挑战，且碰撞与跌落频发。
keyPointsEn: The framework integrates physics simulation, social constraints (embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue), and event-driven task-state updates into a closed-loop evaluation of long-horizon embodied agents.
A frozen multimodal large language model revises decisions through multi-level executable skills, observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback, without fine-tuning the model itself.

The benchmark contains 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes, with five paired conditions examining perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task updates, human coordination, and intent understanding.

The authors' evaluation of 8 MLLMs reports that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, task updates and human interaction remain challenging, and collisions and falls occur frequently.
cards.limitations: 证据边界需明确：其一，评估基于作者构建的 TARSphere-Bench 与仿真环境，场景为30个室内场景、360个情节，不能直接外推到真实机器人部署或其他任务域。其二，受测模型为8个多模态大模型，比较结论受共享动作接口、决策预算和提示设定影响，未必反映其他配置下的排序。其三，“通用模型可优于具身模型”以及“任务更新与人机交互仍困难”属作者在其基准上的报告，尚未见独立复现。其四，碰撞与跌落提示安全性问题，但原文未给出安全指标阈值或与任务成功的权衡分析。其五，基准由智能体在环策展构建，任务与场景的选择可能引入偏差。
cards.originalTitle: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries should be clear. First, evaluation relies on the authors' TARSphere-Bench and simulation, with 30 indoor scenes and 360 episodes, and cannot be directly extrapolated to real robot deployment or other task domains. Second, the tested models are 8 multimodal large language models, and comparative conclusions may depend on the shared action interface, decision budget, and prompting, not necessarily reflecting rankings under other configurations. Third, the claims that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models and that task updates and human interaction remain difficult are the authors' reports on their benchmark and have not been independently reproduced. Fourth, collisions and falls indicate safety concerns, but the source provides no safety thresholds or trade-off analysis with task success. Fifth, the benchmark is built via agent-in-the-loop curation, so task and scene selection may introduce bias.
cards.title: TARSphere：面向机器人的长程具身智能体全栈框架

cards.summary: hallmark是一个面向Claude Code、Cursor和Codex等AI编程工具的设计技能，作者将其定位为反AI套路的界面设计约束。输入内容仅有仓库描述与来源信息，未给出具体规则清单、实现方式或评测结果。其价值是否成立，取决于该技能的具体内容与实际使用效果，而现有材料不足以判断。
cards.description: 该仓库为Claude Code、Cursor和Codex提供一个名为hallmark的设计技能，定位是反AI套路化（anti-AI-slop）。新意在于把设计规范作为可加载技能直接嵌入AI编程代理；其用途是让代理在生成界面代码时遵循既定设计约束。
cards.whyItMatters: AI编程代理生成的界面常趋于同质化，若设计约束能以技能形式直接注入编码流程，可能影响代理输出界面的默认风格；但这一潜在作用需以该技能的具体规则与实测效果为据，当前信息不足以确认其实际价值。
cards.titleEn: Anti-AI-Slop Design Skill for AI Coding Tools
cards.summaryEn: hallmark is a design skill aimed at AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, framed by its author as anti-AI-slop interface design constraints. The input contains only the repository description and source metadata, with no rule list, implementation details or evaluation results. Whether its value holds depends on the skill's actual content and real-world use, which the available material cannot establish.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Interfaces generated by AI coding agents often converge on similar styles; if design constraints can be injected into the coding workflow as a skill, they could shape the default look of agent-produced interfaces. This potential effect depends on the skill's concrete rules and measured outcomes, which current information cannot confirm.
cards.descriptionEn: The repository provides a design skill called hallmark for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, positioned as anti-AI-slop. Its novelty is packaging design guidelines as a loadable skill for AI coding agents; its purpose is to make generated interface code follow stated design constraints.

该项目的自我定位是反AI套路化（anti-AI-slop）的设计约束。

The project describes itself as anti-AI-slop design constraints.
The input only contains the repository blurb and a source entry, with no rule details, examples or evaluation data.

cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is limited to one repository blurb from GitHub Trending Daily (title, source and a single-sentence description). It contains no specific design rules, technical implementation, code quality, usage examples, user feedback or quantitative evaluation, so effectiveness, scope and reliability cannot be judged; nothing here constitutes adoption or investment advice.
cards.title: 面向AI编程工具的反套路设计技能

cards.summary: 研究将理性套利者、操纵者和散户羊群跟随者分别定义为不同的强化学习智能体，并在共同环境中用DQN和REINFORCE训练。基于AAVE、ETC、SUI小时数据的试点显示，羊群跟随者产生最频繁但最短的压力事件，操纵者产生最少但最持久的压力事件，理性智能体滚动夏普比率最稳定。作者据此提出行为特定监管优于统一波动或换手限制的观点，但试点数据仅用于激发假设，结论尚未经过充分验证。
cards.description: 该研究将三类行为原型建模为强化学习智能体，在资产无关的暴露控制环境中训练，并基于小时级加密货币数据提出假设，揭示不同智能体行为对压力事件、风险调整表现和流动性的差异化影响。其价值在于为行为特定监管提供初步量化依据，而非统一限制波动或换手。
cards.whyItMatters: 若不同智能体行为对市场压力和风险调整表现的影响存在系统差异，则统一波动率或换手率限制可能无法有效应对各类风险来源，行为特定监管可能更具针对性。
cards.titleEn: Behavioral Heterogeneity of Agentic AI in Automated Markets
cards.summaryEn: The study defines a rational arbitrageur, a manipulator, and a retail herd-follower as distinct reinforcement-learning agents, each with its own reward function, and trains them with DQN and REINFORCE in a common environment. A pilot on hourly AAVE, ETC, and SUI data indicates that herd-followers produce the most frequent but shortest stress episodes, manipulators the fewest but most persistent, and rational agents the most stable rolling Sharpe ratios. The authors argue for behavior-specific regulation over uniform volatility or turnover limits, but the pilot data mainly motivate hypotheses and the conclusions remain to be fully validated.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If different agent behaviors systematically affect market stress and risk-adjusted performance in distinct ways, uniform volatility or turnover limits may fail to address all risk sources, and behavior-specific regulation could be more targeted.
cards.descriptionEn: The study models three behavioral archetypes as reinforcement-learning agents trained in a common asset-agnostic exposure-control environment and uses hourly cryptocurrency data to motivate hypotheses on how heterogeneous agent behavior shapes stress, risk-adjusted performance, and liquidity. Its value lies in providing preliminary quantitative grounding for behavior-specific regulation rather than uniform volatility or turnover limits.
keyPoints: 三类行为原型通过各自奖励函数在资产无关环境中建模，并用DQN与REINFORCE训练。
羊群跟随者压力事件最频繁但最短，操纵者最少但最持久，理性智能体滚动夏普比率最稳定。
SHAP归因分别将上述模式关联到回撤与跨资产信号、短期波动与仓位状态、以及动量。
keyPointsEn: Three behavioral archetypes are modeled via distinct reward functions in an asset-agnostic environment and trained with DQN and REINFORCE.
Herd-followers show the most frequent but shortest stress episodes, manipulators the fewest but most persistent, and rational agents the most stable rolling Sharpe ratios.
SHAP attributions link these patterns to drawdown and cross-asset signals, short-term volatility and position state, and momentum, respectively.
cards.limitations: 证据来自小时级加密货币数据（AAVE、ETC、SUI）的试点，主要作用是激发假设；模型仅涵盖三类行为原型，环境为资产无关的暴露控制设定，结论向其他资产类别和真实市场结构的推广需进一步验证。研究未提供全面样本外检验或实盘证据，行为特定监管建议属于作者观点而非已验证结论。
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from a pilot on hourly cryptocurrency data (AAVE, ETC, SUI) and mainly serves to motivate hypotheses; the model covers only three behavioral archetypes in an asset-agnostic exposure-control setting, and generalization to other asset classes and real market structures requires further validation. The study does not provide comprehensive out-of-sample tests or live-trading evidence, and the behavior-specific regulatory suggestion is an author viewpoint rather than a validated conclusion.
cards.title: 智能体AI在自动化市场中的行为异质性研究

cards.summary: 作者在Merton消费-投资框架下，引入以α为索引的随机积分约定族，统一处理Itô（α=0）、Stratonovich（α=1/2）和Hänggi-Klimontovich（α=1）。关键结果是：漂移项与约定同步变换时最优策略不变；若固定漂移系数数值，则机会集改变。在对数效用下，消费不受影响，但最优组合权重偏移αV^{-1}d_V；对Heston资产，权重表达式含α项，可在不同波动率状态改变符号。作者还指出，仅从收益数据无法识别约定，需额外结构限制。上述均为作者在文中的推导与观点。
cards.description: 本文研究当风险资产动态以参数α的随机积分约定（介于Itô、Stratonovich与Hänggi-Klimontovich之间）表述时，Merton消费-投资问题的变化。新意在于揭示：若漂移项随约定同步变换，最优策略不变；但若数值固定漂移系数，投资者的机会集会改变。有用性在于为量化研究中随机积分约定的选择提供了理论边界。
cards.whyItMatters: 为量化金融中随机积分约定的选择提供了理论依据：约定本身不必然影响最优策略，但漂移项的处理方式会改变模型含义。这提醒研究者在实证与建模中明确约定与漂移的联合设定，并认识到数据识别的局限性。
cards.titleEn: Choice of stochastic-integral convention affects Merton optimal portfolio weight
cards.summaryEn: The authors embed a family of stochastic-integral conventions indexed by α—covering Itô (α=0), Stratonovich (α=1/2), and Hänggi-Klimontovich (α=1)—into the Merton consumption-investment framework. Key results: transforming the drift jointly with the convention leaves the optimal policy unchanged; holding the drift coefficient numerically fixed changes the opportunity set. Under logarithmic utility, consumption is unaffected while the optimal portfolio weight shifts by αV^{-1}d_V; for a Heston asset, the weight contains an α term and can change sign across volatility states. The authors also note that the convention cannot be identified from return data alone without additional structural restrictions. These are the authors' derivations and views.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a theoretical basis for choosing stochastic-integral conventions in quantitative finance: the convention itself need not affect the optimal policy, but how the drift is handled changes model implications. This reminds researchers to specify the joint setting of convention and drift and to recognize data-identification limits.
cards.descriptionEn: This paper studies the Merton consumption-investment problem when risky asset dynamics are expressed under a family of stochastic-integral conventions indexed by α, interpolating between Itô, Stratonovich, and Hänggi-Klimontovich. The novelty is showing that if the drift transforms with the convention, the optimal policy is unchanged; but if the drift coefficient is held numerically fixed, the investor's opportunity set changes. It is useful for clarifying the theoretical bou
keyPoints: 漂移项随随机积分约定同步变换时，最优消费-投资策略保持不变。
固定漂移系数数值时，不同约定会改变投资者的机会集。
对数效用下消费不变，但最优组合权重偏移αV^{-1}d_V；Heston资产权重含α及波动率状态依赖项，可能变号。
仅凭收益数据无法识别所用随机积分约定，需额外结构限制。
keyPointsEn: When the drift transforms jointly with the stochastic-integral convention, the optimal consumption-investment policy is unchanged.
Holding the drift coefficient numerically fixed, different conventions change the investor's opportunity set.
Under logarithmic utility consumption is unaffected, but the optimal portfolio weight shifts by αV^{-1}d_V; for a Heston asset the weight depends on α and volatility state and can change sign.
The stochastic-integral convention cannot be identified from return data alone; additional structural restrictions are needed.
cards.limitations: 结论基于对数效用和特定资产动态（含Heston模型）的解析推导，未涉及数值校准或实证检验；识别约定需额外结构限制，仅靠收益数据不可行；未讨论更一般效用函数或跳跃等扩展。
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rely on analytical derivations under logarithmic utility and specific asset dynamics (including the Heston model), without numerical calibration or empirical tests; identifying the convention requires additional structural restrictions and is infeasible from return data alone; extensions to more general utility functions or jumps are not discussed.
cards.title: 随机积分约定选择影响Merton最优投资组合权重
